title: Senvest Capital
description:
senvest.com zoominfo.com/c/senvest-capital-inc/91423931 Senvest (including Senvest Capital and Senvest Management) is a major international investment firm and hedge fund sponsor managing billions of dollars in assets.
Founded by Richard Mashaal, it specializes in contrarian value investing strategies across public equities, private markets, and real estate.
Headquartered in New York and Montreal, the firm focuses on discretionary investment advisory services and direct capital deployment for institutional clients.
